stem: A technician calibrates an EC meter, then immediately measures a verification standard and gets a value outside the facility tolerance. What should happen next?
choices: Use the meter anyway because calibration was completed
Troubleshoot or service the meter according to procedure before relying on production readings
Change the standard's labeled value to match the meter
Average the failed verification with the calibration value
rationale: Verification checks whether the measurement system performs acceptably after calibration. A failed verification should be resolved before relying on production data.
